 HP govt. employees’ to get 5 percent hike in DA
 Home > Uncategorized > HP govt. employees’ to get 5 percent hike in DA 
 D P Gupta 
 October 23, 2026 
 Uncategorized 
 Himachal Pradesh government has announced to grant the Dearness Allowance (DA) of the officers and the state government employees by 5 percent, enhancing it from 45 percent to 50 percent.
 In an order released by the Principal Secretary  Finance  on Friday ( October 23 ) the state government employees’ and officers governed by the HP Civil Services Rules – 2022 , will be paid the enhanced DA in cash with the salary of October 26, payable in November -26 .
 The orders will be applicable to the state government employees’ covered under the UGC pay scales and separate orders will be issued in regard to payment of arrears accrued  from, 1/7/ 23 to 1/1/24.
